## Setup

Load the package and get the data.

```{r}
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)

# loading the data
data <- ipmdata

# Defining 3 colours I will later use for plotting
col.early <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[1]
col.mid <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[2]
col.late <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[3]
```

Instead of running three separate models using three distinct phases, another option is to run a single model specifying time as a covariate.

This can be done in two ways:

1. Considering time a continuous variable (either as year or month), and then picking three representative time points to depict the phases;
2. Treating time as a factorial variable, with the time instances assigned to three distinct phases (again "early", "mid" or "late").

```{r}
# defining alternative variables
# Year
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year = cut(sampling, 
               breaks = c(0, 13, 25, 37, 49, 62),
               labels = 1:5) %>% as.factor
  )

# Phase
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    phase = cut(sampling,
                breaks = c(0, 18, 26, 36, 46, 62),
                labels = c("early", NA, "mid", NA, "late")) %>%
      factor(levels = c("early", "mid", "late"), ordered = T)
  )

```

## Models

I can now run separate models using different time specifications, and check the model fit.

```{r, eval = F}
# Survival model using year
y1 <- function(){
  survival.year <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ 0 + year + year:s_loc_density
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')),
                          na.action = na.omit)
}


#... and using phase
y2 <- function(){
  survival.phase <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ 0 + phase:s_loc_density
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')),
                          na.action = na.omit)
}

x <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(y2())
system.time(
survival.time <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_time*(s_loc_density) + I(s_loc_density^2)
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')),
                          na.action = na.omit)
)
summary(survival.time)
```
